lines.en: Ponchomon drifts along in the air.
Its cloth body sways as it moves.
It does not quite touch the ground.
It circles its anchor point.
It looks about as it drifts.
Its sleeves trail long behind.
It glides over a dune.

lines.zh: 热风把它的布吹得鼓起来
lines.en: Hot wind fills out its cloth.
It pauses, then drifts on.

lines.zh: 它在仙人掌边绕了半圈
lines.en: It loops half around a cactus.
It drifts slowly but never stops.

lines.zh: 它朝着有动静的方向去
lines.en: It heads toward the noise.
Ponchomon hangs and sways slowly.

lines.zh: 它的拳头松着，没有握紧
lines.en: Its fists hang loose.
An old patch shows on its cloth.
Its head leans off to one side.
It turns over in the air.
Then hangs upside down a while.
Its feet kick idly in the air.
It flicks a sleeve.

lines.zh: 它的影子在地上的圆形很怪
lines.en: Its shadow on the ground is oddly round.
It slowly rights itself.
It seems to be waiting for an order.
Its breathing moves the cloth.

lines.zh: 它忽然不动，像挂在那里
lines.en: It stops, as if hung there.
Then sways again.
Ponchomon turns square to you.
It tilts its head to size you up.
It drifts a little closer.

lines.zh: 它的拳头握了一下又松开
lines.en: Its fist clenches and releases.
A sleeve reaches toward you.
It only taps your shoulder.

lines.zh: 它退开，飘回原来的高度
lines.en: It backs off to its old height.

lines.zh: 它似乎确认了你是主人
lines.en: It seems to have decided you are its owner.
It drifts around to your flank.
A little light plays on its cloth.
It settles beside you and holds.
It waits for you to move first.
It lowers its head to your height.

lines.zh: 它对你露出了一个布做的笑
lines.en: It shows you a smile made of cloth.
Then it starts drifting again.
Its head tips toward you.
Ponchomon is knocked off balance.
A dent shows in its cloth.
It slowly puffs back out.
It withdraws, fists loosening.
Its sleeves sag.
It sways twice and steadies.
A split opens in its cloth.
It dips its head.
Then lifts it again.
It does not seem to intend to flee.

lines.zh: 碰碰兽朝你手上的东西飘来
lines.en: Ponchomon drifts toward what you hold.
A sleeve curls around it.
It lifts it up to look.

lines.zh: 它不是肉食的，只闻了闻
lines.en: Not a meat-eater, it only sniffs.

lines.zh: 它对植物的味道更有兴趣
lines.en: Plant matter interests it more.
It tucks the item into its cloth.
It reaches a sleeve out for more.

lines.zh: 它把东西抱在怀里飘着
lines.en: It drifts with the item hugged close.
It sways once, satisfied.
It drifts back to your side.
It opens a sleeve toward you.

lines.zh: 它对东西的用途很在意
lines.en: It cares what the thing is good for.

lines.zh: 你撞上碰碰兽，像撞进布
lines.en: You hit Ponchomon like hitting cloth.

lines.zh: 它的身体被撞得凹进去
lines.en: Its body dents at the impact.
Then slowly puffs back out.
It backs half a block and steadies.

lines.zh: 它的袖子扫过你的手臂
lines.en: Its sleeve brushes your arm.
It drifts half around you.

lines.zh: 它把拳头举起来，又放下
lines.en: It raises a fist and lowers it.
It is not in the least annoyed.
It merely resettles.
It returns to your side.
Two ponchomon drift together.
Their sleeves tangle.
They turn, one above the other.

lines.zh: 布面互相摩擦，发出轻响
lines.en: Cloth rasps on cloth.
They stop in the same patch of air.
Then drift apart slowly.

lines.zh: 它们的影子在地上分成两个
lines.en: Their shadow splits into two.
Then they come together again.

lines.zh: 像是某种打招呼的方式
lines.en: It seems to be a kind of greeting.

lines.zh: 它们一起朝同一个方向去了
lines.en: They drift off the same way together.

lines.zh: 碰碰兽用袖子卷起东西
lines.en: Ponchomon curls a sleeve around it.

lines.zh: 它把东西举到布脸近处
lines.en: It holds the item up near its cloth face.
It tucks it into a seam.

lines.zh: 它把不能用的吐了出来
lines.en: It spits out what it cannot use.
It keeps only what it can eat.
It drifts off with an armful.

lines.zh: 它把东西放到锚点旁边
lines.en: It sets the load by its anchor.
It smooths its cloth.
It puts a sleeve out for more.
It drifts back to you, pleased.
Ponchomon stops dead.
Its sleeves draw in into fists.
Its cloth pulls taut.
It circles you once.
Its fists come up in front.
It rises half a block.
It steadies in the air, aimed at you.
Its movements turn clipped.
It seems to be calculating range.
It lunges suddenly.
Then snaps back to place.

lines.zh: 它在等一个更好的时机
lines.en: It waits for a better moment.
Ponchomon circles you in the air.
Its height keeps changing.
It probes from above.
The sleeve arrives before the body.
It retreats to another angle.
Its fists stay clenched.
Its shadow sways at your feet.

lines.zh: 它忽然翻了个身，绕到背后
lines.en: It flips over and goes behind you.
It hangs there without moving.
It is counting your breaths.
Its cloth swells again.

lines.zh: 它开始做小幅度的冲撞
lines.en: It begins small feinting rushes.

lines.zh: 碰碰兽一拳打在你胸口
lines.en: Ponchomon punches your chest.

lines.zh: 它的袖子抽在你手臂上
lines.en: Its sleeve whips your arm.
It hurls its whole cloth body in.
It presses straight down from above.
Two punches in a row.
Missing, it flips over.
A cloth corner scrapes your face.
It carries its momentum forward.
It backs half a block and raises its fists.

lines.zh: 它的动作软绵绵的，却沉
lines.en: Its blows look soft, and land heavy.

lines.zh: 它一拳砸在地上，扬起尘土
lines.en: A fist hits the ground, raising dust.

lines.zh: 它的袖子缠住你的手腕
lines.en: A sleeve loops your wrist.
A bulge of cloth appears in the air.
Ponchomon resolves out of the dust.
It slowly rights itself.
Its sleeves turn in the wind.
It settles at about your height.
A film of dust coats its cloth.
It tilts its cloth head and studies you.
Then drifts half a circle around you.
Its shadow lands on the ground.
It settles above a patch of shade.
It hovers a few paces off.
It drifts slowly toward you.

lines.zh: 布边被燎焦，它慌忙拍打
lines.en: A cloth edge scorches; it slaps at it.
It flattens briefly on landing.

lines.zh: 布里吸满水，它直往下沉
lines.en: Waterlogged, it sinks straight down.

lines.zh: 冲击把它抛得翻了两圈
lines.en: The blast tumbles it twice over.

lines.zh: 箭穿进布里，卡在填充物中
lines.en: An arrow sinks into its stuffing.

lines.zh: 怪力让它的布面一阵鼓动
lines.en: Odd force makes its cloth billow.

lines.zh: 营养不良，它的布塌了下去
lines.en: Underfed, its cloth sags.
Lightning locks it in midair.
The void pulls and drags it down.
